sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Battery Change is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "How are the negotiations progressing? I mean, I understand that Prapor needs to mull it over first, but I'm running out of time! Gotta survive somehow while you're building bridges. No complaints against you, obviously. I don't even have any spare batteries now, and electronics can go to shit at any moment. I could even do with a tank battery right now, I might be able to make it work with my BTR. You think you can find one of those? Because without it, it's over for me."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find the item: 6-STEN-140-M military battery
- Hand over the item: 6-STEN-140-M military battery

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +58,700 EXP
- BTR Driver Rep +0.03
- 284,000 Roubles
- 1× Body armor repair kit
"That's a big one! I hope it wasn't too much of a hassle. Alright, just leave it right here. You're doing a lot of work for me, and I won't forget it. Thank you."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
The quest Order From Outside from Lightkeeper will automatically fail if this quest is completed first.
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| 6-STEN-140-M military battery | 1 | Required | No | Needs to be carried and handed over to the BTR Driver. |

If you want to hand over a 6-STEN-140-M military battery which was obtained before accepting the quest, you have to move it to a different inventory slot for the "Find" objective to trigger.

Bug: Accepting the quest and handing over a battery in the same raid does currently not work in local PvE game mode raids.
